$comment: Baseline states a kit records that name no row of packages/brand/kit-copy/components.json, so no other kit can show a counterpart. Each is genuinely the kit's own; test/report.test.ts fails on any other unmatched state and on an entry that no longer matches.

compose.reason: Compose's own component gallery, which no registry row names: accent (a product accent over a host scheme), focus (the D-pad and keyboard focus ring), powered-by (the optional attribution line and badge), presentation (the public KitSignIn with a product presentation, HA-13) and pack-progress (the content-pack download list, which the registry has no component for). Every state a registry row names is recorded under that row's name, so the report pairs it with the other kits.

terminal-node.reason: The terminal's own output: exit-code refusals of a gated command and the --help screens, which have no window.
